Country-specific requirements

Applicants who completed their degree in the countries below must send certified documents by post. Open your country's section to read what the programme office accepts.

Africa

COUNTRY_1 Transcripts must be mailed by the awarding institution.

China

COUNTRY_2 A CHESICC verification report is required.

India

COUNTRY_3 Certified copies must be attested by the university.

Pakistan

COUNTRY_4 Degrees must be attested by the HEC.

Turkey

COUNTRY_5 An e-Devlet graduation certificate is accepted.
